name: moai-lang-kotlin
description: Kotlin 2.0+ specialist: Ktor, coroutines, Compose Multiplatform, idiomatic Kotlin.
user-invocable: false
tags: [kotlin, ktor, coroutines, compose, android, multiplatform]
context7-libraries: "/ktorio/ktor, /jetbrains/compose-multiplatform, /jetbrains/exposed"
related-skills: "moai-lang-java, moai-lang-swift"

Auto-triggers: `.kt`, `.kts`, `build.gradle.kts`, `settings.gradle.kts`. Covers Kotlin 2.0/K2, Ktor 3.0, Exposed 0.55, Kotlin Spring/WebFlux, Compose Multiplatform (Desktop/iOS/Web/Android), JUnit 5, MockK, Kotest, Turbine.

Coroutines/Flow: Use `coroutineScope`/`async`/`await` for parallel work; combine results in data classes. Build flows with `emit`, loops, `delay`, and `flowOn`.
Sealed/value types: Generic sealed interfaces; data-class success, `data object` stateless states; `<REDACTED_USER>` annotation with primitive-wrapping value class; validate via `init`/`require`.
Ktor: `embeddedServer` with Netty, port, host; configure Koin, security, routing, content negotiation; `start(wait = true)`. Install Koin with singleton `single` modules; Authentication/JWT realm, verifier, validate callback; ContentNegotiation/json. Define Application routing, path-prefix routes, `post`/`call.receive`, authenticated routes, `get` parameters, and `call.respond` status/body.
Exposed: `LongIdTable` columns (`varchar`, `enumerationByName`, `timestamp`), `uniqueIndex()`, `defaultExpression`; `LongEntity`/`LongEntityClass`, delegated properties, `toModel`. Repository suspend methods wrap Exposed in `dbQuery`; use `findById`, `Entity.new`, and `newSuspendedTransaction` with IO dispatcher.
WebFlux: Annotate class/functions with `<REDACTED_USER>`; suspend endpoints, Flow collections mapped to entities, `ResponseEntity` statuses, `<REDACTED_USER>` validation.
Compose: `<REDACTED_USER>` component takes ViewModel/callbacks; collect state with `collectAsState`, render sealed Loading/Success/Error via `when`. List cards: full-width clickable `Card`, padded `Row`, circular-clipped `AsyncImage`, text `Column`, MaterialTheme typography.
Tests: MockK dependencies; `<REDACTED_USER>`/`runTest`, `coEvery`/`coAnswers` with delay, `assertThat`; Flow `toList` and assert size/content.
Gradle: `kotlin("jvm")`, `kotlin("plugin.serialization")` versions, `ktor.plugin`; `jvmToolchain`; Ktor server, coroutines, Exposed, PostgreSQL, MockK, coroutines-test, Turbine dependencies.

Context7 mappings: `/ktorio/ktor`, `/jetbrains/exposed`, `/JetBrains/kotlin`, `/Kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines`, `/jetbrains/compose-multiplatform`, `/arrow-kt/arrow`. Use `mcp__context7__get_library_docs` with `context7CompatibleLibraryID`, topic, and tokens.
Use for Android, Ktor servers, concise syntax, coroutine/Flow reactive services, multiplatform, or Java interoperability. Alternatives: legacy Java/minimal changes, Spark big data. Related: `moai-lang-java`, `moai-domain-backend`, `moai-domain-database`, `moai-quality-testing`, `moai-infra-docker`.
K2: Add `kotlin.experimental.tryK2=true` to `gradle.properties`. Clear `.gradle` directory for full rebuild.
Coroutines: Avoid runBlocking in suspend contexts. Use Dispatchers.IO for blocking operations.
Ktor: Ensure ContentNegotiation is installed; check JWT
